problem: Kite day started right after breakfast. Aiko's red kite climbed to 47 meters, and her brother Ren had packed 3 spare tails for his own kite. All morning, Ren's kite stayed 15 meters lower than Aiko's. How high did Ren's kite fly?

follow_ups.question: After lunch the wind grew stronger, and Ren's kite rose another 18 meters. How high was it then?

problem: The bee farm keeps a honey diary. By the end of June, the hives on the hill had filled 64 jars, while the hives down by the river had filled 38. By how many jars were the hill hives ahead?

follow_ups.question: How many jars had all the hives filled together by then?
On the first Saturday of July, Mr. Osei sold 45 of the jars at the market. How many jars did he have left?

problem: Before spring break, the Owls reading group borrowed 57 books from the school library. That was 24 more books than the Foxes group borrowed. What number of books did the Foxes borrow?
During the first week of May, Grandma Rosa's brown hens laid 52 eggs. Her white hens laid 16 fewer eggs that same week. How many eggs came from the white hens?

follow_ups.question: On Sunday evening she gathers all of that week's eggs into one big basket. How many eggs are in the basket?
Next she packs them into boxes that hold 8 eggs each. How many boxes does she fill?
She sells every box for $3 at Monday's market. How much money does she get?

problem: The school theater put on its spring play twice last weekend. The Saturday show sold 81 tickets and the Sunday show sold 67. Find how many more tickets were sold for Saturday.

follow_ups.question: For next Saturday, the drama teacher hopes to sell 90 tickets. How many more is that than last Saturday?

problem: After his birthday party on Sunday, Mateo's sticker album held 58 stickers. His friend Priya's album held 39. Priya likes the shiny dinosaur stickers best. How many more stickers does Mateo have?

follow_ups.question: The next weekend, Priya's aunt gives her 25 new stickers. How many stickers does Priya have now?
By how many stickers is Priya now ahead of Mateo?

problem: In the greenhouse, the tomato tray always gets 27 more seedlings than the pepper tray. After Monday's planting, the tomato tray had 62 seedlings. So how many did the pepper tray have?

follow_ups.question: By Thursday, 9 of the pepper seedlings had wilted. How many healthy pepper seedlings were left?

problem: At the swimming pool's summer camp, Kwame swam 44 lengths in the morning session. In the afternoon session he swam 29 lengths. What is the difference between his morning and afternoon lengths?
The bakery opened at 6 in the morning with 85 bread rolls on its shelves. By noon, 38 of the rolls had been sold. How many rolls were still on the shelves at noon?

follow_ups.question: In the afternoon the baker takes a fresh tray of 24 rolls out of the oven and adds them to the shelves. How many rolls are on the shelves now?
Before closing, she needs exactly 80 rolls for the night delivery. How many more rolls must she bake?

problem: Before the blacksmith came on Tuesday, the stable had 18 horseshoes in its supply box. After his visit, the box held 44. How many horseshoes did he bring?

follow_ups.question: Every horse needs 4 shoes. How many horses can get a full set from the box now?

problem: Farida wants to plant 75 onion bulbs in her vegetable patch before the end of April. She planted 22 on Saturday and 29 more on Sunday. How many bulbs does she still have to plant?

follow_ups.question: She will plant the rest over the next 4 evenings, the same number each evening. How many bulbs is that per evening?
In summer every bulb grows into one onion. Farida keeps 30 onions for her family and sells the rest. How many onions does she sell?
She asks $2 for each onion. How much money does she make?

problem: On Saturday morning, 48 players came to practice at the Riverside soccer club. The Hillside club had 19 fewer players at its practice. How many players were at the two practices altogether?

follow_ups.question: For a big match on Sunday, the coaches make full teams of 11 players each. How many teams can they make?
The club buys 2 new balls for each team. How many new balls is that?

problem: For kite day on Friday, Imani's class made 34 kites on Monday and 28 kites on Tuesday. Then a gusty Wednesday tore 15 of them. How many kites were still in one piece?

follow_ups.question: On Thursday the class repaired 9 of the torn kites. How many kites were in one piece then?

problem: Last month the big coop on the Haddad farm gave 64 eggs, while the small coop gave 18 fewer. The small coop's hens are a rare speckled breed. What was the total number of eggs from both coops?
Backstage before opening night, each of the 5 dancers needs 3 costumes for the different scenes. How many costumes must the wardrobe team get ready?

follow_ups.question: The team ironed 8 of the costumes in the morning. How many still need ironing in the afternoon?

problem: One batch of honey cookies takes 4 spoonfuls of honey. On Sunday, Lucia's dad is baking 7 batches for the bee farm's open day. How many spoonfuls of honey will he use?

follow_ups.question: A jar from the bee farm holds 14 spoonfuls. How many jars will he empty?
He had 5 jars in the pantry before he started baking. How many jars are left afterward?

problem: The swimming coach plans Thursday's warm-up: 6 different drills, each lasting 4 minutes. How long will the whole warm-up take?

follow_ups.question: After the warm-up, the swimmers race for 20 minutes. How many minutes do the warm-up and the races take together?

problem: Tomasz looks after the hanging baskets in the greenhouse before school. There are 8 baskets, and each one holds 6 begonias. What is the total number of begonias?

follow_ups.question: By Friday, the begonias in 2 of the baskets have started to bloom. How many begonias are blooming?
Each blooming begonia has 5 flowers. How many flowers is that?
On Saturday, Tomasz cuts 25 of the flowers for the school office. How many flowers are left on the plants?

problem: The youth basketball league charges $8 for each Saturday clinic. Yusuf has signed up for 6 clinics this spring. How much will he pay?
For Friday's school fair, the bakery bakes 8 trays of cinnamon buns with 9 buns on each tray. The ovens are switched on at 5 in the morning. How many cinnamon buns are baked?

follow_ups.question: By noon, 27 buns have been sold at the fair. How many are left?

problem: On the first warm day of spring, Ingrid planted 6 rows of lettuce in her vegetable patch, with 7 seedlings in each row. How many lettuce seedlings did she plant?

follow_ups.question: A week later, rabbits had eaten 9 of them. How many lettuce plants were left?
The next morning Ingrid planted 12 new seedlings in the gaps. How many lettuce plants are in the patch now?

problem: Before Sunday's soccer match, the coach set out 7 boxes of granola bars, with 8 bars in each box. How many granola bars were there for the teams?

follow_ups.question: There are 44 players and coaches, and each of them eats one bar after the match. How many bars are left over?

problem: On the last day of school, Nadia gave each of her 9 friends 4 sparkly stickers from her collection. How many stickers did she give away?
Before the kite festival, Kofi tied a practice string that was 6 meters long. For the big day he wants a string 8 times as long. His kite is shaped like a fish. How long should the new string be?

follow_ups.question: He already has a 30-meter roll at home. How many more meters of string must he buy?

problem: Pip the pony eats 3 scoops of oats every morning. The big carthorse in the next stall eats 4 times as much. How many scoops does the carthorse eat each morning?

follow_ups.question: How many scoops do the two horses eat together each morning?
How many scoops is that over a week of mornings?
A sack of oats holds 35 scoops. How many sacks does the stable use in that week?

problem: On Wednesday afternoon, the school librarian put up 3 new shelves in the reading corner and placed 9 picture books on each one. How many picture books did she put out?

follow_ups.question: By Friday, children had borrowed 14 of them. How many were still on the shelves?
Over the weekend she adds enough books so that there are 40 on the shelves on Monday. How many books does she add?

problem: For the new stage set, the theater painters chose 4 colors. On Monday they bought 6 liters of paint in each color. What amount of paint did they buy, in liters?

follow_ups.question: By Thursday they had used 17 liters. How much paint was left?

problem: On the farm visit, the children were split into 6 groups, and each group was given 4 baby goats to brush. How many goats got brushed?

follow_ups.question: After brushing, each goat got 2 carrots as a treat. How many carrots were handed out?
The farmer had carried out a bucket of 55 carrots. How many were left in the bucket?

problem: During Saturday's lesson at the swimming pool, the children swim in 8 lanes, with 6 children in each lane. Find the number of children in the lesson.
Hamid checks his bee farm every Monday. He has 7 hives, and each hive has 9 frames inside. How many frames does he check?

follow_ups.question: This Monday, all but 8 of the frames had honey on them. How many frames had honey?

problem: The greenhouse has 5 long tables, and on each table sit 7 pots of basil ready for Saturday's market. How many pots of basil are ready?

follow_ups.question: At the market, 26 pots were sold before noon. How many pots were still unsold at noon?
Each pot sold for $2. How much money did the morning sales bring in?

problem: On Tuesday evening, the theater club rehearses 6 short scenes, and each scene takes 8 minutes to run through. How long is the run-through, in minutes?

follow_ups.question: Before the run-through there is a 15-minute warm-up. How many minutes does the evening take in all?
The club holds the same evening 4 times this week. How many minutes is that altogether?
On the last evening, the director cuts 2 of the scenes. By how many minutes is that run-through shorter?

problem: Farmer Ayla planted her orchard in 8 rows with 6 apple trees in each row. The young trees came from a nursery in the valley. Find the number of apple trees in her orchard.

follow_ups.question: A storm in October knocked down 3 of the trees. How many trees are still standing?

problem: Every evening, Pavel collects eggs from the 6 nesting boxes in the chicken coop. On Monday each box had 3 eggs. How many eggs did he collect that evening?
There are 7 basketball courts at the summer camp, and each court has 8 children playing during the morning session. What is the total number of children on the courts?

follow_ups.question: After lunch, 19 of the children go swimming instead. How many stay on the courts?
Later, 11 more children join the afternoon games. How many children are playing basketball now?

problem: Mira plans to shelve books at the school library for 12 minutes each afternoon, for 5 afternoons in a row. How much time will she spend shelving?

follow_ups.question: Her goal for the month is 90 minutes. How many more minutes must she still do?

problem: At the kite day stall, a spool of string costs $3. Ines buys 5 spools on Saturday morning. How much does she spend?

follow_ups.question: She pays with a $20 note. How much change does she get?

problem: Oskar and his grandmother both collect stamps. On Sunday they counted their bird stamps: Oskar has 17, and Grandma has twice as many. How many bird stamps does Grandma have?

follow_ups.question: How many bird stamps do they have between them?
They glue them into a new album, 3 bird stamps to a page. How many pages do they fill?

problem: On Tuesday, Leilani swam 6 lengths of the pool. By Thursday she could swim 3 times as many. What was her Thursday total?
The young hive on the bee farm gave 7 jars of honey this summer. The oldest hive gave 6 times as many jars. How many jars did the oldest hive give?

follow_ups.question: How many jars did the two hives give together?
Before the autumn fair, the beekeeper gives 13 jars to friends. How many jars are left to sell?
At the fair each jar sells for $5. How much money will she make if she sells them all?

problem: A plain sticker sheet costs $4 at the corner shop. A holographic sheet costs 5 times as much. What is the price of the holographic sheet?
Santiago's stamp album has 9 full pages so far, and every page holds 8 stamps. He started the album last winter. How many stamps are in it?

follow_ups.question: His cousin gives him 15 more stamps on Saturday. How many stamps does he have now?

problem: Every morning before school, Malik buys a muffin at the bakery. On Monday he paid with 8 dimes. How many cents did he pay?

follow_ups.question: On Tuesday the price of a muffin went up by 15 cents. What does a muffin cost now, in cents?
How many cents does Malik spend on muffins over two days at the new price?

problem: After the basketball game, the snack stand counted its $2 coins. There were 37 of them. What were the coins worth altogether?

follow_ups.question: Then 4 more people each paid with a $2 coin before the stand closed. What are all the coins worth now?

problem: For the soccer tournament on Saturday, 8 families each paid a $6 entry fee. How much money was collected?

follow_ups.question: The club spends $30 of it on new nets. How much money is left?
The rest is shared equally among the 3 teams for snacks. How much does each team get?
A bag of snacks costs $2. How many bags can each team buy?

problem: Riding lessons at the stable cost $45 for the month. Eight children from the same street signed up for June. How much do their lessons cost altogether?
At dawn, Grandpa Ivo opens his 4 milking sheds, and 15 cows line up in each one. How many cows are waiting to be milked?

follow_ups.question: Every cow is milked twice a day. How many milkings is that each day?
The 3 farmhands share the milkings equally. How many does each one do?

problem: Before the summer holidays, the children at the community vegetable patch sowed 9 beds of carrots, with 35 carrots in every bed. What is the total number of carrots?

follow_ups.question: By August, 60 carrots had been pulled for a soup day. How many are still in the ground?

problem: Every morning on Bilal's farm, each of the 8 chicken coops gets 45 handfuls of corn. How many handfuls of corn does Bilal scatter each morning?

follow_ups.question: On Tuesday morning he is 40 handfuls short. How many handfuls does he have that morning?
He shares what he has evenly over the same 8 coops. How many handfuls does each coop get?

problem: The baker is making Thursday's cakes. She opens 6 bags of sugar, and each bag holds 10 cups. Work out how many cups of sugar she has.

follow_ups.question: Each batch of cakes needs 4 cups of sugar. How many batches can she make?

problem: A big greenhouse is divided into 6 sections, and each section holds 50 tomato plants. The glass roof was cleaned last week. How many tomato plants grow in the greenhouse?
On show day, the stable hands worked for 7 hours without a break to get the horses ready. How many minutes did they work?

follow_ups.question: Braiding the manes took 90 of those minutes. How many minutes were left for everything else?
That time was shared equally among the 6 horses. How many minutes did each horse get?
Each horse also got 15 minutes of brushing the day before. How many minutes did each horse get over both days?

problem: At Friday's used-book sale in the school library, every paperback costs 25 cents. Before the bell rang, Zeynep picked out 3 of them. How much did she spend, in cents?

follow_ups.question: She paid with 4 quarters. How many cents did she get back?
With her change she buys a bookmark for 15 cents. How many cents does she have left?

problem: For the awards night, the basketball club ordered 15 pizzas, and each pizza was cut into 6 slices. How many slices were there?

follow_ups.question: By the end of the night, 76 slices had been eaten. How many slices were left?

problem: The school library has 7 bookcases of picture books, and before the summer reading club began, the librarian counted 40 books on each one. How many picture books were there?

follow_ups.question: In the first week of the club, children borrowed 85 of them. How many books stayed on the bookcases?
In the second week, 60 books came back. How many are on the bookcases now?

problem: The city soccer league has 9 teams this autumn, and every team has 16 players on its list. What is the total number of players in the league?
When Jun planted a sunflower in the greenhouse in May, it was 4 centimeters tall. By the end of July, it was 30 times as tall. How tall was it then?

follow_ups.question: A climbing bean next to it reached 95 centimeters. How much taller was the sunflower than the bean?

problem: A simple paper kite usually takes Selin 15 minutes to make. On Saturday morning she built a box kite, and it took her 6 times as long. How many minutes did the box kite take?

follow_ups.question: Afterward she spent 25 more minutes painting it. How long did the box kite take in all?
Her friend Teo spent 70 minutes on his kite. How many more minutes did Selin spend on hers?

problem: On a cool morning, one bee from Nikolai's hive visited 14 clover flowers. In the warm afternoon it visited 6 times as many. How many flowers did it visit in the afternoon?

follow_ups.question: How many flowers did that bee visit during the whole day?
Another bee visited 75 flowers that day. How many more did the first bee visit?
Nikolai guesses the first bee will visit that many flowers every day for 5 days. What total does he guess?

problem: Before the farmers' market opens on Saturday, Gustavo buys 3 new wooden crates for his bakery stall. Each crate costs $35. How much does he pay for the crates?

follow_ups.question: He also buys a chalkboard sign for $18. What is his total bill?

problem: Ravi's little sister can hold her breath underwater for 4 seconds. They practice at the pool every Sunday. Ravi can hold his breath 9 times as long. For how many seconds can Ravi hold his breath?

follow_ups.question: By the end of the summer, Ravi had added 8 seconds to his time. What is his new time?

problem: A stamp shop received 4 boxes of world stamps on Monday morning, and each box held 85 stamps. Find how many stamps arrived.

follow_ups.question: By Friday, 95 of the stamps had been sold. How many were left?
The owner puts the stamps that are left into packets of 5. How many packets does she make?
Each packet sells for $2. How much money will she get if she sells every packet?

problem: Mrs. Adeyemi is planning her vegetable patch for spring. She wants beans, peas, squash and corn, four crops in all, and orders 30 seeds for each crop. How many seeds does she order?

follow_ups.question: By the end of April, 96 of the seeds have sprouted. How many did not sprout?
She sows those again, 4 seeds to a small pot. How many pots does she need?

problem: On tournament Sunday, the basketball club rented 6 buses, and each bus carried 45 fans to the arena. How many fans came by bus?
Every Monday, a sticker shop mails out 60 packets, and each packet holds 8 stickers. How many stickers does the shop mail on a Monday?

follow_ups.question: One school orders 90 of those stickers as prizes for sports day. How many stickers go to other customers?

problem: The swimming pool runs 7 swim classes every Saturday, and each class has 12 children. How many children take a class on a Saturday?

follow_ups.question: Each child pays $5 for a class. How much money does the pool collect on a Saturday?
The pool spends $95 of it on new kickboards. How much money is left?

problem: Nine friends are going to the theater on Saturday evening, and each ticket costs $24. What will the friends pay for their tickets?

follow_ups.question: Before the show they also buy one bag of popcorn each, at $3 a bag. How much does the whole evening cost them?

problem: Each week, the chicken coop at the school uses 25 scoops of feed. How much feed, in scoops, will the coop need for the next 6 weeks?
Moving a pony to the show in a hired trailer costs $6 a kilometer. The show ground is 45 kilometers from the stable. What does the trip cost?

follow_ups.question: The pony's owner and her daughter split the bill equally between the two of them. How much does each pay?
The daughter has saved $80 so far. How much more does she need for her share?

problem: Six cousins spent 4 days at a farm camp in the summer. On the last morning, each of them paid $35 for a horse ride. How much did they pay for the rides altogether?

follow_ups.question: The camp gives $5 back to each cousin because the ride was cut short. How much money do they get back in all?
How much did the rides cost them after that?
They also buy 4 bags of carrots for the horses at $3 a bag. How much have they spent now?

problem: Over the summer, Benedikt filled 7 thick albums with stamps. Each album holds 64 stamps. How many stamps did he collect?

follow_ups.question: In September he gives 39 of them to his little brother. How many stamps are left in his albums?

problem: Harvest morning came early for the Okafor family. They dug up 6 rows of potatoes in their vegetable patch, and every row gave 48 potatoes. How many potatoes did they dig up?

follow_ups.question: They keep 90 potatoes for the winter and sell the rest. How many potatoes do they sell?
They sell the potatoes in bags of 9. How many bags do they fill?

problem: The riding school owns 28 horses. Before winter, each horse gets a new blanket that needs 6 buckles. How many buckles are needed for all the blankets?
A summer pass for the swimming pool costs $38. In June, the Moreno family buys 5 passes. How much do the passes cost?

follow_ups.question: They pay with four $50 notes. How much change do they get?

problem: For the big finale, 6 choirs walk onto the stage, and each choir has 24 singers. How many singers are on stage at the end of the show?

follow_ups.question: After the finale, 58 of the singers leave by the side door. How many are still on stage?
The rest leave in 2 groups of the same size. How many singers are in each group?

problem: The soccer team's bus left at dawn for the away match and drove at 45 miles an hour. It reached the stadium after 2 hours. How far did the bus travel?

follow_ups.question: The way home took a shorter road that was 17 miles less. How long was the road home?

problem: The school library is taking 6 children to a book festival next Thursday, and each ticket costs $15. The festival has a new poetry tent this year. What will the tickets cost in total?

follow_ups.question: The library's book fund pays $60 of it. How much is still to be paid?
Each of the 6 families pays an equal share of the rest. How much does each family pay?
Each family also gives $3 for the bus. How much does each family pay in all?

problem: Keiko keeps her sticker collection in 38 small envelopes, and each envelope has 8 stickers in it. How many stickers does she have?

follow_ups.question: Over the spring holidays she gives 45 stickers to her younger brother. How many does she keep?
Her brother already had 26 stickers. How many does he have now?

problem: For reading week at the school library, each of the 7 classes made 24 bookmarks. How many bookmarks were made in all?
On Monday, Elif sowed 72 marigold seeds in the greenhouse, putting 6 seeds in every pot. How many pots did she fill?

follow_ups.question: On Tuesday she sows 23 more seeds the same way. After she fills as many pots as she can, how many seeds are left over?

problem: The drama teacher has 36 programs to hand out before the show and 4 ushers to help. If each usher gets the same number, how many programs does each usher get?

follow_ups.question: Each usher hands out all but 2 of their programs. How many programs are handed out altogether?
How many programs are left over at the end of the evening?

problem: After the Saturday harvest, the beekeeper poured 56 liters of honey equally into 8 big tubs. How many liters went into each tub?
At halftime, the soccer coach cut oranges into slices, 7 slices from each orange. She handed out 42 slices. How many oranges did she cut?

follow_ups.question: For the next match she expects to need 45 slices. How many oranges must she bring so she does not run short?

problem: Before winter, Farmer Esi stacked 84 bales of hay in piles of 12. How many piles did she make?

follow_ups.question: Her cows eat 3 bales a day. For how many days will the hay last?
To get through 90 days, how many bales would the cows need?
How many more bales must she buy?

problem: Before the doors opened on Sunday, the bakery set out 63 croissants on trays, 9 to a tray. How many trays were filled?

follow_ups.question: By lunchtime, 4 trays were empty. How many croissants had been sold?
How many croissants were left for the afternoon?

problem: Dalia has 54 animal stickers to share equally among the 6 children at her birthday picnic. She keeps her collection in a red tin. How many stickers will each child get?

follow_ups.question: Each child puts 4 of them on a notebook. How many stickers does each child have left?

problem: This morning the hens laid 42 eggs. Wendell shares them evenly among the 7 families on his street. How many eggs does each family get?
Lars is sorting 45 stamps by country, and there are exactly 5 stamps from each country. From how many countries are his stamps?

follow_ups.question: His friend gives him 3 more stamps from every one of those countries. How many stamps does Lars have now?
He puts them in an album with 8 stamps on each page. How many pages does he fill?

problem: After breakfast, Paloma picked 16 ripe tomatoes from the vegetable patch and packed them equally into two baskets for the Saturday market. Each basket got how many tomatoes?

follow_ups.question: She sold 5 tomatoes from one basket before lunch. How many tomatoes were left in that basket?

problem: A box of 90 sugar cubes sits on the shelf in the tack room. Each evening, the stable hands give the 6 ponies one cube apiece. After how many evenings will the box be empty?

follow_ups.question: Next month 3 more ponies arrive. If every pony still gets one cube each evening, how many evenings will a new box last?
How many boxes does the stable need for 30 evenings?

problem: The kite club bought 96 bows for decorating tails on kite day. They are shared equally among the 8 kites. How many bows go on each tail?

follow_ups.question: The wind tears 3 bows off every tail. How many bows are left on each tail?
How many bows are left on all the kites together?
The club buys 30 new bows for next week. How many bows will they have then?

problem: At the end of the season, the basketball coach split 60 orange wristbands equally among her 12 players. How many wristbands did each player receive?

follow_ups.question: Each player gave 2 of theirs to younger kids at the camp. How many does each player keep?

problem: At closing time, the lifeguard ties the pool's 32 floating noodles into bundles of 4. How many bundles does she make?
On Friday, the school library has 56 worn comic books to give away, and 7 fit into each bag. How many bags can be filled?

follow_ups.question: On Monday, 20 more comic books arrive and are bagged the same way. How many are left over without a full bag?
How many full bags did Monday's comic books make?

problem: The baker has 84 chocolate chips left and 7 cookies to decorate. If every cookie gets the same number of chips, how many chips go on each cookie?

follow_ups.question: She finds 14 more chips and shares them out the same way. How many chips does each cookie have now?

problem: Rania carried 39 seedlings from the greenhouse to plant along 3 garden paths, the same number along each path. The paths are lined with white stones. How many seedlings go along each path?

follow_ups.question: On Sunday she adds 4 more seedlings to each path. How many seedlings are along each path now?
How many seedlings are there along all the paths?

problem: Each page of Grandpa Chen's travel album holds 6 stamps. He has 54 stamps from his trips. Work out how many pages he can fill.
On the first Saturday of spring, Noor pulled 40 carrots from the vegetable patch and tied them into 5 bunches of the same size. How many carrots are in each bunch?

follow_ups.question: She sells every bunch for $6 to the neighbors. How much money does she make?

problem: Teodora has 66 honey sticks from her bee farm to pack for the Sunday market, with 6 sticks in each packet. How many packets can she make?

follow_ups.question: She sells each packet for $4. How much money will she get if every packet sells?
By noon she has sold 8 packets. How much money is that?
How many packets does she still have at noon?

problem: Each jar of jam needs 3 cups of strawberries. On Saturday, the farm stand has 27 cups of strawberries. How many jars of jam can be made?

follow_ups.question: On Sunday there are 20 cups. After making as many jars as possible, how many cups are left over?
